fact: As of 22 January 2025 a draft street naming and addressing policy awaits final approval, and the ZICTA National Addressing and Postcode Project, launched in 2012, is building a web-based address database and installing street signs and house numbers.
title: Initial steps made in standardization and creation of a uniform system of administering geographical names in Zambia
publisher: United Nations Group of Experts on Geographical Names
